title: My Niece Forged Documents, Took $750K, And Repaid My $92K. So I Let Her Sort Handbags
description: After my niece forged dissolution papers to steal the $750,000 sale of our vintage boutique, she thought returning my $92,000 investment would hide everything. I proved the forgery, won the brand’s intellectual property, and reopened as ‘Second-Hand Vows.’ Now she sorts inventory for me with a lanyard that reads ‘Original Forger.’ #RevengeStory #FamilyBetrayal #JusticeServed
thumb_text: SHE STOLE $750K, NOW SHE SORTS MY HANDBAGS
pinned_comment: If your niece forged documents to steal a $750,000 sale after you invested your husband’s pension, would you have let her wear that ‘Original Forger’ lanyard? Share your story in the comments.

thumb_lines.text: I INVESTED MY HUSBANDS PENSION AND OWNED 40 PERCENT
